items.title: Oraclum Hedge Fund Founder Is Charged With Lying About Returns
items.description: Vuk Vukovic, a founder of New York hedge fund Oraclum Capital LLC, was charged by federal prosecutors with lying to investors about his fund’s performance.

items.title: Hungary Gives Targeted Payments to Offset Soaring Fuel Costs
items.description: Hungary will give 20,000 forints ($64) per car to hundreds of thousands of drivers through the end of the year to help offset the impact of soaring fuel prices, the government said.
